summary: Recorded the pending-ReadIndex lifetime that bounds the primary defect. raft.reset replaces the readIndex queue with a fresh one, clears the vote and votes map, clears the pending configuration flag, aborts leader transfer and rebuilds the remote, observer and witness maps; becomeFollower, becomeCandidate and becomeLeader all call it. So a confirmation in a later term cannot confirm a request left behind by an earlier one, and the stranded read can only end at the caller's deadline with a client reissue as the recovery path. Added two source ranges, a behavior entry and an explicit knowledge use, plus a limitation stating that boundary. Conclusion, defect claim and receipts are unchanged. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false. No execution was run.
